facts.text: The 4+1 Police Program enables criminal justice majors to earn a bachelor's, full-time MPTC municipal police certification, and a master's degree in five years.

sources.title: Police Program (4+1) Concentration, Criminal Justice, BS | Fitchburg State University
sources.quote: In five years, you will receive (in this order) a Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, an MPTC full-time municipal police certification and a Master's degree in Criminal Justice.
